recommendation: Productionize wrist-conditioned crop re-detection as the tracker's paddle-lost fallback: when the paddle track has no association for >=1 frame, run D-FINE on {256,704}px crops around BOTH pose wrists (never trust handedness for wrist choice — Apple Vision swaps L/R on rear views; rally2's overhead lives on the 'left_wrist' of a right-handed player), floor 0.08, cross-scale NMS, and feed the boxes into the EXISTING two-stage association as detection-source=crop candidates gated by the track/wrist distance — never as raw detections into selection. Expected gains from rally2 dev evidence: S0 event-window recovery 5/11 → 8/11 @IoU.30 (11/11 @IoU.10), including the two documented misses (2603 contact-blur via crop256 @0.36 IoU, edge-on carry 2936/2970 @0.84/.63); this un-starves rally2's S3=0 ownership slice and (diagnostic, held-out) supplies tight target boxes on 13/13 dink wrong-player frames for wave-a's planned wrist-distance ownership prior to flip. Keep temporal propagation only as an explicitly-flagged TRACKED_ESTIMATE bridge for <=2-frame residual blur holes (wrist-anchored mode, missA 5/7 ≥.30); do NOT ship TTA. Wave-C checklist: (1) implement crop re-detect in the tracker gap path, (2) suppress the near-body FP family (shorts/leg/court-line, banner/stripe cousins) with the sidecar hard negatives before raising crop candidate trust, (3) re-run paddle-bench S0/S3/S5 with wm-dink-01 still quarantined, (4) fix the -ss seek off-by-one in the run-dets extraction (one-frame timestamp bias contaminates cross-artifact comparisons).
